Commentary.Commentary: 308 isn't such a bad total on this batting wicket, and if West Indies can get off to a good start and keep their heads, the target should be within their reach. Join us in a short while for the run chase.

West Indies were once again rudderless with the ball. They were taken for runs all around the park and left clueless. They however did well to pull it back towards the end and keep Pakistan from another big score. Alzarri Joseph was once again good as he scalped 2 wickets, with Holder, Narine, Benn and Pollard picking 1 apiece.

Azhar Ali finally made a ton after a rusty patch while Babar Azam racked up his 3rd consecutive ton in this series. They made gigantic 147-run stand before the skipper got out and set it all up for the middle order. Unfortunately, the batsmen to follow couldn't capitalize on that and failed to score runs towards the end of the innings. Only two boundaries were scored in the last 10 overs and the home side will feel they missed out on a big score here.

Pakistan will be disappointed with the way they have ended their innings. 212/1 in 35 overs and then just managed to score 96 in the last 15. After opting to bat, they got off to a flying start. Sharjeel Khan and skipper Ali got their team off to a flying start but then the former threw his wicket away. Then it was Azhar Ali and Babar Azam who took over the reins. The pair played with fluidity and were flawless in their knocks.
Fuller ball on middle and off, Nawaz looks to give this a full swing of the bat but gets it off the inner half of the bat towards backward square leg for just a single. PAKISTAN FINISH ON 308/6!
Pollard sees Nawaz coming down the track and fires this one wide outside off, the batsman tries to dig it out on the off side but gets beaten.
Another short ball with no pace at all, pulled away towards long on for another single.
In the air... safe! Slower length delivery on middle, Sarfraz backs away and tries to go straight down the ground. Mistimes it as the ball falls safely near mid on. A single is taken.
Fuller length and outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
Slower full ball wide outside off, Nawaz looks to go after it but misses.
MOHAMMAD NAWAZ is the new man in!

OUT! IMAD HOLES OUT! Alzarri Joseph bangs it in short and around off, Imad Wasim tries to pull this away but gets a thick top edge on this. It lobs over towards deep mid-wicket where Bravo takes a good catch by running behind a bit to his right to get under it. Another wicket down for the Men in Green.
Back of a length delivery on the stumps, this time Imad Wasim looks to play the reverse paddle but fails to make any connection. A dot ball. Frustrating for Pakistan, this.
Slower back of a length delivery outside off, an off cutter, Imad Wasim shuffles way across and paddles it over the keeper's head. Gets two runs for doing so.
Banged in short and wide outside off, Ahmed punches it to point and sets off for a single. There's a shy at the striker's end but that misses and so, a single is taken.
Short ball which is pulled in the air. It went off the glove and Sarfraz is lucky the fielder at short fine leg went back to the deep. Two runs are taken.

FOUR! That's an amazing shot. Just the second boundary in the final 10 overs. Used the pace well there, Sarfraz. Knowing Joseph will be looking for the yorker, he positions himself early to paddle this away. Gets it past short fine leg and away to the fence.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. They pick up a single.
Low full toss on off, eased down to long off for a single.
Fuller ball on off, driven through mid off for a single.

NOT OUT! The decision stays as it is! Slower full ball outside off, Imad gets way across and down on one knee and tries to sweep. He completely misses it and is hit on the pads. They appeal but the umpire says not out. Replays show impact was in the line but Wasim was well outside the crease so the question of hitting the stumps go out of the box. A leg bye is taken.
An LBW decision is referred upstairs.
Touch short on middle, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Ahmed makes room and Pollard follows with a fullish delivery. The Pakistan keeper drives it down the ground for a couple.
Short of a length delivery on middle, pulled away towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller in length and angled on the pads, flicked through mid-wicket by Imad for a single to get off the mark.
IMAD WASIM is the next batsman in.

OUT! The decision stays as it is! Alzarri Joseph strikes! The umpire took his time to give his call but it was the right one. Joseph bowls it on a length around off, nipping back in a touch as Rizwan is late to bring his bat down to defend. The ball hits his pads and a loud appeal follows. The umpire raises his finger. Rizwan opts for the review and replays show it was in line and was going on to clip the stumps.
LBW decision by Rizwan is taken upstairs!
Touch short and angling in, Rizwan tucks it towards mid-wicket for another double.
On a length and around the pads, worked through the on side for a couple.
Fuller ball on middle, Ahmed makes room and hits it down the ground for a single.
MOHAMMAD RIZWAN walks in next!

OUT! You miss and I hit! Pollard fires a yorker on middle and leg, Azam gets down and across as he tries to paddle sweep this one. Completely misses it and the ball hits the timber. No real celebration from West Indies as they know the damage is already done. This is 50th ODI wicket for Pollard! Azam gets a standing ovation as he trudges back to the pavilion. Well played, Babar!
On a length and angling in, Ahmed pulls it over mid-wicket for just a single.
Fuller on off, driven straight to mid off.
Good length delivery on the pads, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Poor from Lewis! Short of a length delivery, slower in pace. Azam skips down the track and pulls it through mid-wicket. Lewis in the deep makes a mess of it and concedes a boundary.
Fuller in length delivery outside off, Azam drives it down the ground for a double.
KIERON POLLARD will have a go here with the ball.
Full ball fired in on the stumps, it's driven down to long on for a single.
An attempted yorker which just misses. It's whipped through mid-wicket by Azam for a couple of runs. Pollard out in the deep does well to run to his right and cut it off. Saves a boundary.
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Slower ball on leg stump, Babar clears his front leg and skews a lofted drive towards long on for one.
Fuller ball around off, Babar Azam makes room and lofts it over covers for a single.
Full toss on middle and leg, it's whipped through the mid-wicket region for a single.
ALZARRI JOSEPH is back into the attack.
Babar looks to pierce the gap through the off side but is unfortunate to find the fielder.
Shortish in length and pitched wide outside off, Azam rocks back and punches it towards deep extra cover for two more runs.
Full and attacking the stumps, Sarfraz drives this down to long on for a single.
Babar Azam turns this one towards backward square leg for a run.
3rd ODI hundred for Babar Azam! It's third in a row for him in this series, mind blowing stuff!

There it is! Flat and way outside off, Babar Azam stays back, reaches out to it and punches it to deep cover for a brace. This is his 3rd consecutive ton in this series. The lad is in fine form. He removes his helmet, punches the air and celebrates as his teammates cheer him on. What a knock. Beautiful.
Tossed up around off, Babar Azam wrists this straight to the man at mid-wicket.
Full ball on the stumps, driven to mid on. Dot ball.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Another off-cutter around off, it's worked behind square on the leg side for an easy two.
Off-cutter around off, Sarfraz gets an inside edge to the leg side and a single is taken.
Wide! Length ball going down leg, wide signalled.
Pitched up on off, driven down to long on for a single.
Length ball outside off, driven square of the wicket on the off side for two runs.
Short and wide outside off, chopped to sweeper cover for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Flighted well outside off, pushed to cover-point for one.
Flatter and quicker outside off, hit to sweeper cover for a run.
Tossed up on middle and off, swept through backward square leg for a run.
Outside off, played to point for nothing.
Holder is on the floor and being looked at by the physio. Maybe he pulled his calf, or his hamstring, not sure. Guess it's the heat getting to him. But there's a slight halt in play due to that.
Pitched slightly ahead of a length and around off, it's driven down to long off. Some good, hard running between the wicket allows the batsmen to come back for the second. Good stuff.
Sarfraz Ahmed plays this down towards the mid on region and scurries to the other end to complete a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Shortish ball on the body, Sarfraz Ahmed gets on top of the bounce and pulls it through to deep mid-wicket for another single.
Fuller length ball angling in on off stump, Sarfraz taps it gently on the off side. Wants the single but is sent back.
Wide! Length delivery going down the leg side, wide signalled by the umpire.
On a good length and outside off, Babar backs away a bit and cuts it towards backward point for a single.
On middle and leg, worked towards short mid-wicket.
Full outside off, Ahmed opens the face of the bat and guides it towards short third man.
SARFRAZ AHMED walks into the middle next to bat.

OUT! Edged and it's taken! Malik departs without troubling the scorers much. Narine bowls a flatter ball outside off, Malik looks to cut this one through the off side but gets a bottom edge which is pouched beautifully by Ramdin behind the stumps. Not easy to take those, but West Indies have picked up two big wickets here.
Full ball around middle, Malik shuffles across and flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Flatter on middle, Malik punches it down to long on for a single.
Short and outside off, Azam slams it through covers but will get only one as there is protection out in the deep.
SUNIL NARINE is back on!
On middle and leg, eased down to long on for another single.
On a length and outside off, punched off the back foot towards covers for one.
Good length delivery on off, Malik pushes it towards covers for a couple to get off the mark.
Length ball on middle, flicked towards mid-wicket.
SHOAIB MALIK is the next batsman to walk in.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Double A you gotta go! Jason Holder gets a crucial breakthrough! He bowls a cutter around off, Ali comes down the track and gives it a full swing of the bat to thwack this one. Misses it completely as the ball goes on to crash the off pole. He is gutted at himself and has to walk back but not before playing a superb innings. The 147-run stand has been broken. Can West Indies capitalize from hereon?
Touch short on middle, Azam pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Another short ball outside off, Ali cuts it straight to point.
Full and around off, Azam drives it hard through covers for a single.
Around middle, pushed off the front foot towards mid on.
3rd ODI ton for Azhar Ali!

Double A gets to his ton here! He is absolutely ecstatic here, he punches the air in joy and kisses the turf. What a knock this has been! Coming to the ball, short and outside off, Ali camps back and flays it past backward point. They pick up three runs.
Comes down the track and flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Flatter one around middle, Azam gets back and punches it down to long on for a single.
Full on middle, flicked behind square on the leg side for one.
Fullish ball on middle, Ali gets across and works it through mid-wicket for a single.
Third man and mid off up now as Azhar Ali is on 97...
Good length delivery on middle, tucked through square leg for one.
Full and angling in, flicked past the man at mid on for a single.
Full and around off, driven past the man at point for a single.
FOUR! Edgy! Short of a length delivery outside off, Azam looks to cut but he gets an outside edge between backward point and short third man for a lucky boundary.
Drinks are on the field!
Loopy ball around middle and off, Azam drives it through the gap at covers for a single.
Floated delivery around off, Azam pushes it off the front foot towards covers.
Tossed up ball around middle and off, Azam drives it back to the bowler.
Driven past mid off for a single.
Short and outside off, punched off the back foot towards covers for a single.
Azam comes down the track and chips it over mid on. Didn't hit it hard and gets a couple to his name.
It's punched to mid off but the batsmen take no run for it.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Slightly fuller outside off, it's cut square of the wicket on the off side for a couple of runs.

Leg bye! HUGE LBW APPEAL! It's turned down but Holder's face says he thinks otherwise. Length ball coming in on middle and leg, Azhar Ali walks across to flick this away but misses and is hit on the pads. Holder turns around and loudly appeals for a leg before but the umpire isn't interested. He's looking to Ramdin to see if he should take the review against the decision or not but there's no signal from the keeper. Replays show that the ball was going above the stumps so WI lucked out with that. A leg bye is taken.
Length ball on middle and off, Azam with a short-arm jab through the mid-wicket region. It goes out to the man in the deep as a single is taken.
Length ball around off, Ali works it towards wide mid on for a brisk single.
Full on off, Babar prods forward and defends it into the track on the off side.
Benn gives this a decent amount of flight and pitches it on off stump, AA dances down the wicket and drives it through covers for a single.
Short and flat on off, it's pulled through to deep mid-wicket for another run.
Flatter ball on middle stump, drifting in, Ali skips down the track and pushes it to long on for one.
Floats this one up nicely just outside off, Azhar pushes it to covers for nothing.
Tossed up on the stumps from around the wicket, it's eased down to long off for a single.
SULIEMAN BENN is back into the attack!
Length ball outside off, steered to third man for a run. Sensible batting, this.
FOUR! Too straight and too full and that's whacked. Half-volley outside off, Babar Azam spots it early and gives it the full swing of the bat. Hammers it over long off for a boundary.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Ali swivels across and paddles it down to fine leg for one more run.
Pitched on a length once more, outside off, it's punched to covers for a quick single.
On a good length and pitched outside off, Azhar opens the face of the bat and guides it down to third man for an easy single.
Length ball angling in, worked to mid-wicket.
Another shortish delivery from Joseph, the pull is mistimed to mid-wicket.
Back of a length delivery outside off, punched to extra cover off the back foot.

On a length and outside off, Azhar cuts it towards point and sets off for a single. There is a shy by the fielder there and he ends up hitting Ali instead of the stumps at the bowler's end. One run completed.

FOUR! EXQUISITE! That's been played with so much control and guile. Back of a length delivery outside off, Azhar Ali stands tall, and with perfect balance, pulls it hard through the mid-wicket region to get another boundary to his name.
Slightly fuller in length and outside off, it's driven through covers for one.
Back of a length delivery around off, Babar Azam gets a top edge on his pull shot. He clears the infield over mid-wicket and gets a couple of runs as the man cuts it off in the deep.
Outside off, guided towards backward point.
Back of a length delivery around off, Babar mistimes his pull down to long on for a comfortable single.
Full ball on off, it's driven down to mid on. Won't get any run for it.
Outside off, Babar went for the dab on the off side but ended up getting a bottom edge behind towards the keeper.
100-run stand between Ali and Azam!
FOUR! Very short and it's dispatched! Short of a length delivery around off, Babar Azam is in perfect control of this shot. He drags the pull through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Length ball angling in on middle and off, Azhar Ali hops across and flicks it through square leg for a single.
JASON HOLDER is back on!
Fuller one on the stumps, Azam gets across and flicks it towards the man at mid on. Ali wanted a single but won't get it.
Pulled towards fine leg on this short ball and a single is picked up as well.
Touch short and outside off, Azam slaps it past point for one.
Angles it on middle, worked towards mid-wicket.
Short of a length ball on middle, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
6th ODI fifty for Babar Azam!

Another fifty for Azam and this bloke is in some unreal form at the moment. Raises his bat and acknowledges the cheers from his mates. Angles it on the pads, clipped through backward square leg for a single. He has started off well can he get a ton again today?
Eased down to long on for one. 5 singles and a dot from that over.
Loopy and full around off, Ali sweeps it through mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Again a flat ball on middle, Azam gets back and just punches it back to Narine.
Azam gets forward and pushes it towards covers. Ali wanted a single but Azam shouts "NO" and sends him back in time.
Flatter one on off, punched past the man at covers for a single.
Landed outside off, Ali glides it behind point for a single. 12 off the over, a good one for Pakistan!
Full and angling in, worked towards mid-wicket.
Slower bumper on middle, pulled past short fine leg for a single.

FOUR! Bad ball and recieved the treatment truly! Joseph tries to bowl the off cutter, but it goes wrong. Too much of width was there and Azam won't miss out on that one. He crunches it through covers, it's in the gap and crosses the fence in no time.
Slightly short and on the pads, it's tucked behind square on the leg side for a single.

FOUR! Sweet! That's just a punch from the Pakistan skipper! Joseph hurls a length delivery on off, Ali gets behind it and punches it past the bowler down the ground. Mid off gives it a chase but the ball was always going to win the race.
Wide! Angles it down the leg side, Azhar looks to flick but fails to get any wood on it.
ALZARRI JOSPEH comes back on.
Tossed up outside off, Ali once again gets down and sweeps it towards fine leg to keep strike.
On middle and leg, Ali works it towards the right of the bowler.
Full and around off, this time Ali gets what he wanted on the previous ball. Sweeps it uppihsly towards backward square leg for a double.
Loopy ball around off, Ali gets down to sweep but misses and it's a good take by Ramdin behind.
Flatter through the air and around off, punched down to long off for a single.
FOUR! Finds the gap! Narine throws this one short and outside off, Azam camps back and slashes it through backward point for a boundary. Into the 40s he moves now.
SUNIL NARINE is back into the attack.
Full ball just outside off, driven hard straight to the man at covers. Dot ball to end the over.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Back of a length and angling in on the hips, Azhar Ali comes across, hops and tucks it down to fine leg for a single.
On a length and outside off, it's dabbed down to third man for a single.

FOUR! EDGED AND AWAY! It's hot, the conditions are tough and that makes it all the more difficult to see the edge fly away. Length ball angling in, outside off, Babar Azam plays this away from his body and gets a thick edge. It flies through the vacant slip cordon and away behind to the third man boundary.
Length delivery angling in on off, Azhar stays back and punches it straight to mid on. A single is taken.
Benn bowls this well outside off, Ali drives it back down to long off for a single to end the over.

SIX! THAT'S OFF THE MEAT OF THE BAT! A lot sweet and a lot meatier. Tossed up by Sulieman Benn from around the wicket, Azhar Ali kneels down and drags the slog sweep high and mighty over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. Really stamping his authority here now, Azhar Ali.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Beautiful shot. Babar Azam makes good use of his feet and gets to the pitch of the delivery. Brings the wrists into the play as well and lofts it over mid-wicket to pick up a boundary.
Ali gets to the pitch of this full ball and drives it down to long on for a single.
From around the wicket, a flatter one which is drifting in with the angle, it's punched to the off side.
Length ball outside off, it's punched in front of covers off the back foot for nothing. That'll be the end of the over.
Coming in sharply off the deck, on middle and off, flicked through backward square leg for one run.
Fuller length ball around the off stump, driven through the cover region for a run.
Babar Azam has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

It's a catch taken but it won't count. Back of a length delivery angling in to the body, Azhar Ali rocks back and pulls it over square leg. Sunil Narine out in the deep runs to his right and takes the catch but it's of no use. A single is taken.
Free Hit coming up...
No ball! Back of a length delivery outside off, Azam punches it to deep point for one. It's a no ball though as Gabriel overstepped his line.
Short of a length delivery around off, it hurries on to Babar Azam who ends up pulling it down towards mid on.
It's too full and there's a lot of width on offer, Babar Azam gets to the pitch of the delivery and drives it towards sweeper cover for a single to end the over.
Been loops this one up nicely outside off, it's pushed off the front foot in front of covers.
Slider outside off, it's punched through covers for an easy two.
It's swept away through square leg for a run.
FOUR! He's taken the aerial route and put it away. Loopy and full on the stumps, Azhar Ali gets down on his rear knee and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket send it all the way.
Tossed up delivery on the stumps, Babar Azam dances down the track and eases it down to long off for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, it's slashed through to deep point for a run.

IN THE AIR... BUT IT'S SAFE! The Pakistan skipper has caught a lucky break here. Back of a length delivery outside off, Azhar Ali looks to drag the pull over mid-wicket but gets a top edge. It's lobs over to mid-wicket and falls safely as the batsmen take a single.
Fullish in length and pitched outside off, Babar Azam drives it square on the off side towards deep backward point for one.
Fuller length delivery just outside off, straightening up a touch, Azam punches it to the man at covers.
Length delivery outside off, room to free his arms and Babar Azam does well to helps it past the diving point fielder for a brace.
Length ball aiming the top of off stump, Azhar Ali stays behind and punches it towards mid on for a quick single. Good running between the wickets.
Pakistan are shaping up well here. West Indies badly need a wicket and they need it soon.
SHANNON GABRIEL is back into the attack!
Around middle and leg, Ali gets down the track and flicks it past mid-wicket for a single.
Around middle and leg, Ali gets down the track and flicks it past mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy delivery around off, Azam drives it towards long off for a single.
Short and around off, punched off the back foot towards covers.
Flatter through the air, it's clipped past square leg for a single.
Full and around middle, Azhar comes down the track and drives it back to the bowler.
Drinks are on the field!
10th ODI fifty for Azhar Ali!
There it is, a much-needed half century for the skipper. He wasn't in great form and today he had to do well. Looped up around middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Drive past covers for a single by Babar.
Loopy around off, Babar drives it towards covers.
Defended into the ground by the batsman.

SIX! Down the track and away she goes! Loopy ball around off, Azam wears his skates, gets to the pitch of the ball. He knew mid off is inside the circle so he lofts and lofts it neatly to clear the long off fence. Brilliant shot from the man in form. 100 up for Pakistan!
Tossed up ball around off, Ali gets down and sweeps it through backward square leg for a single.
Darted in on middle, nudged straight to the man at short mid-wicket.
Babar has pushed it to the cover region.
Full and around middle and leg, Ali flicks it down to long on for a single.
Full and fired around off, Ali makes room and drives it back to Benn.
Loopy delivery around middle, Azam gets to the pitch of the ball and works it past mid on for a single.
Tossed up around middle, coming in as well. Azam gets forward and clips it towards mid-wicket.
Loopy full around off, BA drives it through covers and will keep strike.
Azam presses forward and drills it past covers. It's in the gap and they get an easy brace.
Full and around off, pushed through the off side for a single.
Ali gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads.
Quicker around off, Ali looks to play it with the spin but gets beaten.
Rocks back and punches it down to long on for a single.
Azam sees the loop, comes down the track and drives it down to long off to keep strike.
Flighted ball around off, Ali leans into it and pushes it excellently through covers for a single.
Ali comes down the track and tries to drive it past the bowler but the big man Benn dives full length to his left to deny them a single.
Drags this one short and around off, Babar camps back and punches it through covers for a single.
Full and around middle and leg, flicked towards short mid-wicket.
Shortish around off, Azam cuts it straight to the man at point.
Quicker one around off, tight lines there from Narine. Ali defends it down. Superb over as just a couple came off it.
Tossed up around off, Ali drives it straight to the man at mid off.
Flat and short outside off, Ali gets back and tries to cut but fails to pierce the gap.
Around off, Ali tries to drive but the ball skids in and he is forced to defend.
Loopy ball around off, Ali gets forward and pushes it towards covers.
Full and around middle, Ali gets down and across. He paddles it away down to fine leg. Easy two picked up.

Some nice flight given to this by Sulieman Benn, it's looped up well and has plenty of drift on it too. Babar Azam does well to be patient and not commit to a shot. He stays back, lets the ball come on to the bat and defends.
Looped up and well outside off, Azhar Ali plays with the spin and drives it through the gap in the covers to get a run to his name.
Slides this one into the pads, it's nudged down to short fine leg.
Babar Azam comes out to this one and eases it down to long on for a single. Is off the mark with that.
Around the off stump, it's kept out off the back foot.
BABAR AZAM is the new man in, replacing Sharjeel! Can he make 3 consecutive tons?

OUT! BENN WITH THE BREAKTHROUGH! Finally, just the thing West Indies needed, a wicket. The left-armer tosses it up around off, Sharjeel gets down to this one and slogs it away. Looks to clear the long on boundary but doesn't get the distance on it. Alzarri Joseph is the man out there and it's straight down his throat. He does well to hold on to it and dismiss the southpaw opener.
Azhar Ali is beaten as he looks to cut it away. Was fizzing it and was a little too full to cut.
Fullish in length and pitched outside off, it's driven square on the off side for a run.
Darted way outside off, Azhar Ali still manages to get down to this one and drag the sweep down to fine leg for a single.
Once again it's on the pads, it's flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Flat on the pads, Sharjeel gets rapped on the pads as he closes the face to flick it away. No harm done as the ball pitched outside the line of leg stump.
Narine tosses it up on middle and leg, Sharjeel works it to the on side with soft hands.
Flighted nicely by Benn, it's wristed back down towards wide long on for a run and that will be the end of the over.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and on the pads, Azhar Ali works this fine down the leg side and picks up three runs as the fielder at fine leg puts in a good diving effort to save the boundary.

From around the wicket, Benn with a flatter ball around off, drifting in, Azhar Ali dances down the wicket and gets rapped on the pads as he looks to flick. A muted appeal but the umpire turns it down.
Nicely looped by Sulieman Benn, around off, Sharjeel just eases this down towards long on for a single.
Benn with a floated ball around off, it's defended off the back foot to the off side.
SULIEMAN BENN into the attack now!
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tossed up by Narine and pitched outside off, the left-hander drives it towards sweeper cover for one more easy run.
Narine keeps attacking the stumps, tight line as Sharjeel flicks it to the man at mid-wicket.
On the stumps this time, flatter in trajectory, it's swept down towards fine leg for another run.
Sunil with a tossed up delivery outside off, some drift on that occasion, the Pakistan captain gets an inside edge onto his pads as he tries to defend that.
Narine bowls this outside off, it's eased through the covers for an easy single.
SUNIL NARINE is brought into the attack.
FOUR! Brathwaite has a change of angle and comes from over the wicket, pitches it up there outside off, Azhar leans forward and across and sweeps it through backward square leg for a boundary.
Full outside off, driven down to long off for a single.
On middle and leg, turned to the leg side for one.
Play and a miss! Flat ince more, going along with the arm, Azhar Ali looks to cut it away but misses.
Flatter ball on off stump, it's punched down to long on off the back foot for a single.
From around the wicket, a flat ball on middle stump, Azhar Ali skips down the track and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Flicked through the on side for a single to keep strike.

FOUR! Easy as it looks! Back of a length delivery, very close to the off stump channel. Ali arches back a bit, opens the face of the bat and tries to cut but gets a bottom edge past the keeper. Didn't try to over-hit it, just a gently push.
Leg bye! Angles a length delivery on the pads, Khan looks to flick but misses and the ball goes off the pads towards the leg side. A leg bye is taken.
Touch full and angling in, Ali shuffles across and flicks it towards short fine leg for a single. There is a shy at the bowler's end but Ali dives full length to make his ground.
Back of a length delivery on off, tapped towards backward point for a single.
Angles a length delivery on off, Sharjeel tries it steer it down to third man but fails to get any wood on it.
Full around middle and off, driven down the ground for a single.
Tossed up ball around off, nudged through square leg for one.

Edged away! Short and flat outside off, Azhar Ali gets back to punch it through covers but gets a thick outside edge past the keeper and it runs down towards third man. The fielder in the deep cuts it off and keeps them down to a couple.
Loopy and full around off, eased down to long on for a single.
Flatter one around middle and off, Sharjeel defends it back to the bowler.
Bowls it quicker through the air around middle, skidding in with the angle. Khan looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Good length delivery on middle, Ali defends it with the full face of the bat.
Tad short and served outside off, Ali steps out and guides it with an opened face bat towards backward point.
On a length and around off, Ali looks to defend it but the ball goes past the outside edge to the keeper.
Fuller and angling in, Ali leans ahead and drives it straight to the man at mid on.

Back of a length delivery outside off, Sharjeel taps it towards covers and scampers across for a quick single. They are not only dealing in boundaries but are also stealing the singles as and when possible.
Loopy ball around middle and leg, helped past mid-wicket for a single.
Flattish on the pads, tucked towards the leg side.
Flighted delivery around middle and leg, Ali comes down the track and flicks it through the gap at mid-wicket. A single is picked up.
Darted in on the pads, worked towards short mid-wicket.
Full around middle, bunted back to the bowler.
Tossed up around middle and off, defended off the front foot on the off side.
FOUR! 50 up for Pakistan! What a shot! Good length delivery, angled across, Sharjeel cuts it beautifully through point for a boundary.
This time Holder slants this on the pads, Ali tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Good length ball on middle, Azhar flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Angles it on middle and leg, defended on the leg side.
On a length and outside off, Sharjeel punches it towards covers. There is an unnecessary throw made at the bowler's end. The fielder doing the backup fumbles and now they get a single.
Back of a length delivery on off, Ali taps it towards backward point. He wanted a single but there is some confusion in between. Eventually they run.
JASON HOLDER into the attack!
FOUR! Shot. He's in fine from here, Sharjeel Khan. He stays back to this flat ball and cuts it through point to get another boundary to his name.
Continuing from around the wicket to the left-hander and gets it to drift in with the arm, it's worked to mid-wicket for no run.
Azhar Ali reaches out to this one and wrists it to the on side for a quick run.
On the shorter side once more, maintaining that flatter trajectory, Azhar from deep within the crease dabs it towards point with an open face.
Flatter and shorter outside off, Sharjeel dabs it wide of long on for an easy run.
He starts off from around the wicket, darts in a flatter delivery on middle and leg, it's worked in front of mid-wicket for a single.
KRAIGG BRATHWAITE comes into the attack.

FOUR! Typical Sharjeel Khan shot. Length delivery on the hips and he doesn't think twice about what he's going to do about this. He swivels across and pulls it past the short fine leg region for a boundary. Pakistan are dealing in boundaries here.
Once again it's around off, on a length once more, it's kept out.
On a length and just around the off stump, it's defended off the back foot with a solid, straight bat.
Fuller delivery on middle and leg, Azhar Ali taps it down towards mid on for a brisk single.

FOUR LEG BYES! More runs for Pakistan. They're coming thick and fast. Angling down the leg side, Azhar Ali looks to flick this away but misses as the ball goes off the thigh pad. It beats the keeper behind and runs away to the fine leg fence for a boundary.

FOUR! Length ball outside off, width on offer and Azhar Ali's eyes light up. He stands his ground and slashes this past point as the ball rockets away to the boundary. Crashed that, really. Brilliantly played.
FOUR! Beautifully placed. Fuller and straying on the pads, Sharjeel Khan clips this past short fine leg to pick up a boundary. Put away a bad ball.
This kept quite low. It's well outside off, Sharjeel goes for the pull but misses as the low bounce takes the ball under the bat.
A cross seam delivery, pitched just back of a length and going away, outside off, Khan looks to pull this hard through mid-wicket but fails to make any connection.
Full from Joseph, attacks the base of off stump, the southpaw drives it towards mid on. A good dive from the fielder there saves a certain boundary. Good effort.
Slightly fuller in length and angled across, Sharjeel Khan plants his front foot forward and shoulders his arms to that one.

Shortish delivery around off, Sharjeel latches onto this quickly. Rises and rides the bounce as he drags the pull through mid-wicket. Kieron Pollard out in the deep does well to run to his right and stop it with his right foot. Keeps the batsmen to two runs.
A full ball around off, it's kept out solidly off the front foot with the full face of the bat.
Another full ball from Shannon Gabriel, attacks the stumps as it's driven to the right of him.

FOUR! This is the ideal start for Azhar Ali. Terrific shot. It's full and outside off, with excellent balance, Azhar Ali leans into the shot and drives it back down the ground. It races away to the fence as the umpire signals a boundary.

Slightly fuller in length and pitched just outside the off stump, Sharjeel taps it with soft hands to the off side and hesitates to run. But a sure call from his partner convinces him to rush across and take the run. Good work from Azhar.
Length delivery angled across the left-hander, Sharjeel Khan from deep within his crease looks to cut it away but gets a bottom edge towards point.

FOUR! Gabriel with a full ball angled across, Sharjeel leans into the shot and punches it through point. That shot was all about timing. Didn't hit it too hard and sent it all the way to the boundary line.
SHANNON GABRIEL to bowl from the other end!
FOUR! Shot. Quite full and coming in on middle and leg, it's too straight as Azhar Ali is onto this in a flash. Makes good use of the wrists and flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Some early swing for Alzarri Joseph. He fires it in full and outside off, the ball shapes away as Ali reaches out to play at it.
Length ball well outside off, easy leave for the batsman.
Slip comes out of place. Another fielder is brought inside the circle on the off side.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Azhar camps back and punches it through the covers for two more runs. Nice timing and the placement was good as well.
Sharp bumper from Joseph. Bangs it in hard and angling in, Azhar Ali ducks under it well and evades it.

Alzarri Joseph comes running in, starts off with a length delivery and gets it to angle in to Azhar Ali, the Pakistan skipper stays back and works it through the mid-wicket region for a couple of runs. Off the mark straightaway.

It's time to play the game. The umpires and players have made their way out to the middle. SHAREJEL KHAN and AZHAR ALI will open the batting for Pakistan. ALZARRI JOSEPH to start off with bowling proceedings with a couple of slips in place. Here we go!!!
TEAM CHANGES FOR WEST INDIES - SHANNON GABRIEL and EVIN LEWIS replace Carlos Brathwaite and Johnson Charles.
TEAM CHANGES FOR PAKISTAN - They have made a forced change as Mohammad Amir has gone home due to his mother's illness. SOHAIL KHAN comes in his place.
WI PLAYING XI - Kraigg Brathwaite, Evin Lewis, Darren Bravo, Marlon Samuels, Denesh Ramdin(w), Kieron Pollard, Jason Holder(c), Sunil Narine, Sulieman Benn, Alzarri Joseph, Shannon Gabriel.
PAK PLAYING XI - Azhar Ali(c), Sharjeel Khan, Babar Azam, Shoaib Malik, Sarfraz Ahmed(w), Mohammad Rizwan, Imad Wasim, Mohammad Nawaz, Wahab Riaz, Hasan Ali, Sohail Khan.
TOSS - PAKISTAN WIN THE TOSS AND OPT TO BAT!

Hello and a warm welcome for the 3rd and final ODI between Pakistan and West Indies in Abu Dhabi. The Men in Green have literally dominated the series so far and if they manage to continue that today as well, they will be replacing West Indies in the ICC ODI rankings. West Indies have lost the series already and you can argue that this is a dead rubber, but mind you, West Indies will not only fight for pride but not let themselves slip down in the rankings. There's plenty to look forward to and let's hope we get a good contest today.
